t0018-01.gloss: A locked studio and an unsigned check remain on the same page.
t0018-01.rival_reading: A broadcast worker could secure the studio before any emergency and leave the checklist unfinished; the blank box does not prove a failed containment order.

t0018-02.gloss: A field sketch and a water mark sit under the studio desk glass.
t0018-02.rival_reading: A reporter could sketch field reports and spill water while working; neither the stain nor the drawing identifies a program.
